modelFitReason: Flat rate with published standard deductions by filing status fits the calculator model.
localTaxNote: North Carolina does not levy a local income tax on wages. Confirm before publishing.

notes.text: North Carolina's individual income tax rate for 2026 is a flat 3.99%. Revenue triggers in state law may reduce it in later years.
The standard deduction is $12,750 for single and married filing separately, $25,500 for married filing jointly or surviving spouse, and $19,125 for head of household.
